title: Social Debiasing for Fair Multi-modal LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with generated counterfactual images varying by gender and measuring the predictive skew (using MaxSkew and MinSkew metrics) in the models' assignment of various social concepts (e.g., occupations, personality traits, educational status).

Prompting Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with generated counterfactual images varying by race and measuring the predictive skew (using MaxSkew and MinSkew metrics) in the models' assignment of various social concepts (e.g., occupations, personality traits, educational status).

Prompting Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with generated counterfactual images varying by age (young vs. old) and measuring the predictive skew (using MaxSkew and MinSkew metrics) in the models' assignment of various social concepts (e.g., occupations, personality traits, educational status).
